title: When you keep searching but do not settle
issueStatement: You keep moving, reading, comparing, and trying things, but inwardly nothing is actually landing.
centralInsight: Restlessness is not always hunger for truth. Sometimes it is resistance to the stillness where truth would actually meet you.
practicalReflection: Guru does not flatter spiritual roaming. Guru asks whether the heart has cooled, become patient, and come under word and company.
actionPrompt: Pause one more search. Return to one line, one practice, one sangat, and stay.

source.shortMeaning: Movement and ritual can keep multiplying while peace does not.
source.lifeApplication: Restlessness sometimes survives by calling itself sincerity.

excerpts.explanation: This is the clearest anti-restlessness text in the archive.

source.shortMeaning: Circling and wandering do not cool the fire; word and company do.
source.lifeApplication: Restlessness often needs direction more than novelty.

excerpts.explanation: Restlessness and doubt often feed one another.

source.shortMeaning: The real conquest is inward, and it ends in bowing.
source.lifeApplication: Do not let restless motion masquerade as inner victory.

excerpts.explanation: The cure is not lethargy, but redirected battle.
